lines.speaker: coach
lines.text: Hi Mercedes, it's Jorge from the coaching program. Is now still a good time?

lines.speaker: participant
lines.text: Hey, yeah, I was waiting for your call.

lines.speaker: coach
lines.text: Great. So today I'd like to hear how the soda swap went, check how you're feeling, and pick a goal for next week. Anything you want to add?

lines.speaker: participant
lines.text: Sounds good to me.

lines.speaker: coach
lines.text: How are you doing, really?

lines.speaker: participant
lines.text: Okay. The heat is getting to me.

lines.speaker: coach
lines.text: Got it.

lines.speaker: coach
lines.text: So last time your goal was to swap soda for water on 5 days. How did that go?

lines.speaker: participant
lines.text: Uh, it went really well, I actually did it 5 times.

lines.speaker: coach
lines.text: You're still figuring out what works.

lines.speaker: participant
lines.text: I can do water at lunch, maybe not dinner yet. My neighbor started doing it with me.

lines.speaker: coach
lines.text: You've got a plan in mind already.

lines.speaker: participant
lines.text: I feel better about myself when I stick to it.

lines.speaker: coach
lines.text: Do you think 5 days is realistic?

lines.speaker: participant
lines.text: No, not really.

lines.speaker: coach
lines.text: Would it be okay if I shared something that's helped other people?

lines.speaker: participant
lines.text: Go ahead.

lines.speaker: coach
lines.text: Some people switch to seltzer with a little lime first. It still has the fizz.

lines.speaker: participant
lines.text: I want to get my energy back.

lines.speaker: coach
lines.text: It's completely your call.

lines.speaker: coach
lines.text: Do you have a water bottle you like?

lines.speaker: participant
lines.text: Not yet.

lines.speaker: coach
lines.text: You'd rather start small and actually stick with it.

lines.speaker: participant
lines.text: Yeah, if I plan it the night before, I can do it. Some days are better than others.

lines.speaker: coach
lines.text: You think you can do it.

lines.speaker: participant
lines.text: My kids is why I'm doing this.

lines.speaker: coach
lines.text: Would it be okay if I shared something that's helped other people?

lines.speaker: participant
lines.text: Yes, please.

lines.speaker: coach
lines.text: Some people switch to seltzer with a little lime first. It still has the fizz.

lines.speaker: coach
lines.text: Right.

lines.speaker: participant
lines.text: Mm-hmm.

lines.speaker: coach
lines.text: Some people switch to seltzer with a little lime first. It still has the fizz.

lines.speaker: participant
lines.text: I put a reminder on the fridge.

lines.speaker: coach
lines.text: If you don't do this, your health is going to suffer.

lines.speaker: participant
lines.text: Okay.

lines.speaker: coach
lines.text: What would your family say about these changes?

lines.speaker: participant
lines.text: Good question.

lines.speaker: coach
lines.text: Do you mind if I tell you what some people do?

lines.speaker: participant
lines.text: Yes, please.

lines.speaker: coach
lines.text: Some people switch to seltzer with a little lime first. It still has the fizz.

lines.speaker: participant
lines.text: I really want to feel like myself again.

lines.speaker: coach
lines.text: Is your daughter able to help?

lines.speaker: participant
lines.text: Yeah, I think so. It was a long weekend with family, you know how it is.

lines.speaker: coach
lines.text: Next week I want you to swap soda for water on 3 days.

lines.speaker: participant
lines.text: I know, I know.

lines.speaker: coach
lines.text: On a scale of 0 to 10, how confident are you that you can do that?

lines.speaker: participant
lines.text: Like a 10.

lines.speaker: coach
lines.text: I'll text you midweek to see how it's going, and we'll talk again in two weeks.

lines.speaker: participant
lines.text: Can we do a little later? I have an appointment.

lines.speaker: coach
lines.text: Talk soon!

lines.speaker: participant
lines.text: Thank you, talk soon.

tags.note: Energy goal; coach did not reflect or explore
Third verbatim repeat of seltzer tip

flags.reason: Seltzer-with-lime tip repeated verbatim at lines 18, 29, 32 and 40 without new engagement; it reads as a script.
Warning 'your health is going to suffer' pushes advice with fear and no permission; MI non-adherent.
Assigned 3-day goal unilaterally after participant had proposed her own plan; no negotiation.
Energy-return motivation ('I want to get my energy back') and line 41 were not reflected or explored.
Participant asked to reschedule for an appointment; coach ignored the request and closed the call.
Participant said 'The heat is getting to me' in a cancer survivor; coach said 'Got it' and did not ask about it.

score.summary: Mercedes reported success with the soda swap and offered her own plan, but Jorge repeated the same seltzer tip four times, warned her about health consequences, and imposed a 3-day goal. He also ignored her request to reschedule and did not explore her energy and family motivations.
strengths: Line 8: opened by reviewing last week's goal and asking how it went, which invited her success.
Line 23: complex reflection 'You'd rather start small and actually stick with it' matched her stated preference well.
Line 20: 'It's completely your call' respected her autonomy.
Line 16 and 38: asked permission before sharing suggestions.
coaching_tips: Line 29, 32 and 40: the same seltzer tip was repeated verbatim; offer ideas once, then ask what she thinks would work.
Line 34: replace the health warning with a reflection, e.g., 'Your energy and your kids seem to matter a lot to you.'
Line 44: negotiate the goal with her, e.g., 'What feels doable next week?' rather than assigning 3 days.
Line 19 and 41: reflect her energy and 'feel like myself' change talk and ask what she'd like to get back.
Line 49: acknowledge her appointment request and offer a later time before closing.
Line 6: follow up on 'The heat is getting to me' with an open question about how she is managing it.
